title: Apple iPhone Duo Orders Slip Into 2027 Amid Preorder Frenzy
summary: Shipping estimates for Apple Inc.’s first folding phone, the iPhone Duo, slipped into January within minutes of the company opening preorders on Friday, suggesting that strong demand and sharply constrained supply will make the $1,999 device challenging to purchase on its Oct. 23 release date or in the near future.

title: Why Investors Are Turning to Bond ETFs
summary: Fixed-income ETFs are drawing investor interest as rising yields offer a chance to lock in around 5%. Paisley Nardini, the Head of Investment Strategy at Tema ETFs joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explain why some asset allocators are shifting gains from equities and how concerns about AI earnings growth and debt-funded spending are shaping the market outlook. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: European Shares Outperform S&P 500 Amid Defensive Tilt From AI
summary: European stocks rose, headed for their biggest weekly outperformance over the S&P 500 since April 2025, as the region benefits from a switch among investors out of the AI trade and from some positive earnings news.

title: Drones Hit Russian Industrial Site Deep in Western Siberia
summary: A Russian industrial facility in the Surgut district, which is home to several oil and gas assets, was hit in a drone attack.

title: MSCI Decision Moves Saylor’s Strategy Toward Index Exit
summary: MSCI Inc. adopted new rules that could ultimately push Strategy Inc. out of its global equity benchmarks, potentially triggering billions of dollars in stock sales and adding fresh pressure to the financing model behind Michael Saylor’s vast Bitcoin holdings.

title: Citi's Kaiser Isn't Ready to Step In on Chip Stocks
summary: Stuart Kaiser, Citi's head of equity trading strategy, says stocks have endured a painful week beneath the surface, even as the S&P 500 has held near record levels. Kaiser also says valuations are demanding, with clients viewing earnings expectations for 2027 and 2028 as largely priced in, making it easier for risks to outweigh potential upside further out. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: EverWind To Build Nova Scotia Data Center, Lease to AI Developer
summary: EverWind Fuels Co. has announced more than C$10 billion ($7.1 billion) for a data center campus and wind generation infrastructure in Nova Scotia, calling it the largest privately funded investment in the province’s history.

title: Tesla Reveals Flying Roadster Built With SpaceX Tech
summary: Elon Musk reveals a new prototype of Tesla's Roadster sports car at a SpaceX facility in Texas. The car includes air thrusters which can launch the vehicle into the sky. Musk showed off this capability at the event. The car won't go into production until 2028. Musk says this shows what can happen when his companies work together. Bloomberg's Craig Trudell reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: CoreWeave Stock Wipeout Exposes Divide Between AI Fear and Greed
summary: CoreWeave Inc. has become caught in a tug of war between investors who see rising bond yields as a potential rally killer for the AI trade and those who think demand for computing power will make those concerns seem passe before long.

title: Schwab CEO on AI Strategy, Investing Trends, and ‘Charlie’
summary: Rick Wurster, president and CEO at The Charles Schwab Corporation, discusses customer trends in investing, efforts to attract younger investors, and why the firm is blocking unauthorized AI agents. He speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Tesla Unveils Roadster With a Nod to SpaceX Merger
summary:
Tesla shares rose in premarket trading Friday morning after Elon Musk unveiled 
its long-delayed Roadster sports car that includes air thrusters. The car actually launched into the sky during an event at a SpaceX rocket facility in Texas. Musk has been signaling he may try to combine the companies. Matthew Bloxham of Bloomberg Intelligence has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Why Neuberger Has Neutral Stance on Global Stocks
summary: Neuberger Multi-Asset Strategies Co-CIO Maya Bhandari says the firm recently cut back its stance on global equities to “at target” for the first time in four years, with Europe still underweight due to its cyclical bias, heavy concentration in autos and banks, and limited AI exposure. She tells Bloomberg this is in contrast to Japan and China, with their stronger earnings and valuations. (Source: SBS Studio)

title: Nvidia’s Huang and Broadcom’s Tan See the AI Boom From Slightly Different Places
summary: The CEOs offer slightly different views on investor concerns

title: Palantir, Apple, Microsoft Prepare for Democratic Oversight Push in Congress
summary: For two years, congressional Democrats furious over corporate America’s cooperation with the Trump administration have been limited to the sternly worded letter.

title: ARK’s Wood Says CoreWeave Will Overcome Debt Fears on AI Demand
summary: Concerns over CoreWeave Inc.’s high borrowing costs are common for young companies raising money when interest rates are elevated, but investing in the AI computing supplier will pay off, according to Cathie Wood of ARK Investment Management LLC.

title: China Plans AI Export Curbs to Exert Control Over Key Tech
summary: China proposed adding advanced artificial intelligence technologies to its export-control list, potentially restricting overseas transfers of AI models and chip designs in an effort to tighten control over homegrown advancements in a strategically important sector.

title: Emerging Stocks, Currencies Rebound After Week of AI-Led Swings
summary: Emerging-market stocks rose as investors returned to South Korea’s technology shares, while easing bets on an imminent US interest rate hike helped boost developing nations’ currencies.

title: Nscale IPO: Data Center Delays Show Risks for the Neoclouds
summary: Angry workers and fires delay key buildout in the fjords

title: Taiwan to Curb China AI Chip Exports to Align With US
summary: Taiwan plans to tighten export controls on AI chips in an effort to further align with US restrictions, joining a Trump administration clampdown on the smuggling of semiconductors to China. Neil Campling reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: CoreWeave Faces Funding Risks as Costs Rise
summary: CoreWeave has been become embroiled in a tug of war between investors who see rising bond yields as a rally-killer for the AI trade and those who think rising demand for computing power justifies the enthusiasm. Bloomberg's Neil Campling reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
